## Frequently asked questions

All prices shown are in USD and exclude value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), and other applicable taxes. Taxes are calculated based on your billing address and added to your invoice where required by law. [Learn more about taxes](https://vercel.co/docs/pricing/taxes).

Our Hobby plan is free and a great way to get started. Pro is designed for professional developers, freelancers, and businesses who need enhanced features and team collaboration. Enterprise is for teams seeking greater performance, collaboration, and security. [Contact our sales team ](https://vercel.co/contact/sales) to learn more.

Our limits are listed [here](https://vercel.co/docs/limits). Pro plans have a $20 included credit to use across resources. Finally, check out our [Fair Use Policy](https://vercel.co/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines).

We are glad you are growing with Vercel! You can continue to self serve or [contact us](https://vercel.co/contact/sales) to discuss your requirements and we can customize a plan for your team.

Potentially. Transfer fees are dependent on the TLD and the domain renewal fee. The domain-transfer workflow will alert you of fees before initiating transfer.

Caching responses can reduce the usage of Vercel Functions. If the function response is [cached](https://vercel.co/docs/caching/cdn-cache), it will not run and incur a Function invocation or any GB/hrs of duration. Any request made to Vercel will incur a CDN Request. Requests to static assets incur the same Fast Data Transfer usage if the response is cached or uncached. Further, Vercel automatically adds etags to all responses to prevent end users from downloading the same asset many times. Vercel CDN automatically [compresses](https://vercel.co/docs/how-vercel-cdn-works/compression) responses to reduce your Fast Data Transfer.

We provide customers with tools to observe, control, and alert on their infrastructure spend with [Spend Management](https://vercel.co/blog/introducing-spend-management-realtime-usage-alerts-sms-notifications).

New Pro teams have a default on-demand usage budget of $200 (which can be customized) and receive email, web, and SMS notifications as you reach that amount. When reaching 100%, you can optionally configure Vercel to automatically pause all projects with a hard limit.

Over the past year, we've added features to the platform based on your feedback to help automatically prevent runaway spend, including [recursion protection](https://vercel.co/changelog/automatic-recursion-protection-for-vercel-serverless-functions), [improved function defaults](https://vercel.co/changelog/serverless-functions-can-now-run-up-to-5-minutes), [hard spend limits](https://vercel.co/changelog/improved-hard-caps-for-spend-management), [Attack Challenge Mode](https://vercel.co/changelog/prevent-malicious-traffic-with-attack-challenge-mode-for-vercel-firewall), and more.

Flat Rate CDN is an alternative to usage-based CDN billing available on Pro that provides teams with a predictable monthly bill and traffic spike protection. There are several advantages:

- **Fixed monthly price**: Pay a fixed amount for Vercel CDN each month, regardless of traffic and usage.
- **Covers traffic spikes**: CDN Requests, Fast Data Transfer, and other resources are no longer billed directly.
- **No overages**: Your bill will never increase because of temporary usage spikes.

See the [flat-rate CDN pricing docs](https://vercel.co/docs/pricing/flat-rate-cdn) for more details.
